FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 257
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Donnie Chesteen
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/31/2025
Senate Bill 257 as introduced would authorize the Educational Television Foundation Authority
to use the Authority's funds to engage in fundraising activities. This bill would not affect state
or local funding.
